name: What methods do professionals use to remove smoke smell?

mainEntity.name: What methods do professionals use to remove smoke smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals use a combination of advanced techniques. This often includes ozone generation, which oxidizes odor-causing molecules; hydroxyl generators, a safer alternative that also neutralizes odors; thermal fogging to penetrate surfaces where smoke has settled; and specialized cleaning agents. HVAC system cleaning is crucial to remove trapped smoke particles, and thorough cleaning of all surfaces, fabrics, and contents is performed to ensure complete odor eradication.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals use methods like ozone generation, hydroxyl generators, thermal fogging, specialized cleaning agents, and thorough HVAC cleaning to eliminate smoke odors.
